# Install `changelog-feed` — Changelog Feed

> Canonical /changelog or /whats-new section.

📚 Knowledge base : https://resource.rahmanef.com/llms.txt
📦 Slice detail   : https://resource.rahmanef.com/slices/changelog-feed
🧠 JSON catalog   : https://resource.rahmanef.com/api/knowledge?slice=changelog-feed
🤖 Prompt page    : https://resource.rahmanef.com/agents/changelog-feed

## 1. Install

```bash
npx rahman-resources add changelog-feed
# alias: npx rr add changelog-feed
```

## 2. What it ships

- tags: `ui`, `changelog`, `section`, `saas`, `release-notes`, `marketing`

## 3. Wire it up

Run `npx rr add changelog-feed`. <ChangelogFeedSection entries title subtitle layout sortDescending limit /> — only `entries` required. Each entry: `{ id, version, date, kind, title, body, bullets?, groups? }`. `layout="timeline"` adds a left date-rail; `layout="list"` is the most compact. Pass `limit={3}` on home pages to show recent releases.

## Rules of engagement

- shadcn-only UI primitives. No raw `<button>` / `<dialog>` / native date or file inputs.
- 200-line hard cap per source file (extract neighbours when over).
- All Convex queries hit an index (`.withIndex(...)`); never bare `.collect()`.
- Public mutations/queries declare `args:` validators + authz.
